fork_change: For eligible prefill, stop rounding the actual SM count down to a power of two in fattn-new-mma.cu.
deployed_behavior: Non-stream-K uses nsm * max_blocks_per_sm for wave occupancy.
Stream-K may round to whole output tiles with at most 5 percent occupancy loss; this is not power-of-two SM rounding.
decision: No equivalent power-of-two SM restriction found in our deployed scheduler. Do not port this fork-specific change or claim its reported gain.
